paragraphs.text: CISA added four actively exploited vulnerabilities to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog, including flaws in VMware vCenter Server, Cisco Expressway, SAP NetWeaver, and Apache Roller, while threat actors exploited a VMware vCenter zero-day and rapidly weaponized a Cisco Expressway proof-of-concept. These developments expand the set of critical enterprise assets requiring immediate remediation and compress patching windows for internet-facing infrastructure. Vulnerability owners should confirm asset coverage and remediation status for all listed products.

Microsoft disclosed a breach of its Entra Connect Health service exposing administrator emails and tenant configurations, researchers demonstrated cross-tenant memory access via a KVM hypervisor flaw on AMD hosts, and a critical GPGME library vulnerability affects all applications using OpenPGP before version 2.3.0. These events highlight supply chain and shared-infrastructure risks that extend beyond directly managed assets. Identity, data, and vulnerability owners should assess exposure through Microsoft services, cloud provider isolation, and embedded library dependencies.
